text: MegaFon PJSC is wholly owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding: MegaFon's CEO told RIA Novosti in 2020 that all MegaFon shares were consolidated at shareholder USM, and MegaFon's 2022 annual report lists OOO USM Telecom (50%) and OOO AF Telecom Holding (50%, whose sole owner is USM Telecom) as its only shareholders.
short: MegaFon is 100% owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding.

source.name: Prime via finance.rambler.ru: Холдинг USM консолидировал 100% акций "Мегафона"
source.quote: USM Holding Алишера Усманова консолидировал 100% акций "Мегафона", сообщил РИА Новости гендиректор оператора Геворк Вермишян.
source.note: Translation: 'Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding consolidated 100% of MegaFon shares, MegaFon CEO Gevork Vermishyan told RIA Novosti.' Same page, quoting Vermishyan: 'все акции "Мегафона" будут консолидированы у акционера компании – USM' (all MegaFon shares consolidated at shareholder USM), and on the pre-deal structure: AF Telecom Holding's sole owner is USM Telecom (ООО "ЮэСэМ Телеком").

additionalSources.name: MegaFon PJSC: Годовой отчет за 2022 год (annual report, PDF), p. 2
additionalSources.quote: акционерами ПАО «МегаФон» являлись ООО «АФ Телеком Холдинг» (50%) и ООО «ЮэСэМ Телеком» (50%), которые в совокупности владели 100% уставного капитала Компании
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'the shareholders of MegaFon PJSC were AF Telecom Holding LLC (50%) and USM Telecom LLC (50%), which together owned 100% of the company's charter capital.' Same page: 'Государство в уставном капитале Компании не участвует' (the state does not participate in the company's charter capital). MegaFon's 2025 IFRS financial statements (p. 9, https://corp.megafon.ru/download/~federal/corp/investoram/report/msfo/megafon_2025_ifrs_fs_rus.pdf) state that as of 31.12.2025 the shares are held 50/50 by 'Participant 1' and its 100% owner 'Participant 2', both ultimately controlled by 'Participant 3', itself owned by a group of participants no single one of which controls it; disclosure is limited under Government Decree No 1102 of 04.07.2023.
